claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the scent, describing it as pleasant and manly.
Many users report that it clears up or prevents beard flakes and dry, flaky skin.
A common positive is that only a small amount is needed to lather and clean the beard well.
Some reviewers find the product merely average compared to other beard shampoos.
